subject: Coordinating parallel demo lanes & vendor bridge — please pick a lane
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@acme.dev>, Paul Mendes <paul@dataforge.ai>, marketplace-partner@cloudhub.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating parallel demo lanes & vendor bridge — please pick a lane

Hi all,

Thanks for your interest — excited to run a group technical walkthrough of Redwood Inference next week. We expect multiple prospects (Acme, DataForge, a marketplace partner) to join; to keep things focused we propose running two parallel "lanes" (short product walk + live Q&A) and a shared final 20-minute Q&A.

Proposed lanes for Friday Nov 6: 
- Lane A (EMEA/US friendly): 15:00 - 16:05 UTC (45m demo + 20m shared Q&A)
- Lane B (APAC-friendly): 22:00 - 23:05 UTC (45m demo + join for Q&A as-needed)

If one of those is a hard conflict for your team, please reply with "Lane A" or "Lane B" preference or suggest an alternate 30–60m slot (we can swap Lane start times but prefer to keep the parallel structure).

Logistics notes:
- We'll run demos from a host bridge (Zoom) and spawn breakout rooms for hands-on questions.
- Marketplace partner: please confirm if your vendor bridge requires IP whitelisting — attached is a short checklist we need completed 48 hours prior.
- If you'd like an attended environment (dedicated capacity demo), note that in your reply and we can reserve a demo cluster; this needs a short provisioning notice.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf, vendor-network-checklist.pdf

Next steps: if I don't hear preferences by EOD Thu (Nov 5), we'll default to Lane A for Acme and Lane B for DataForge.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com

From: Jamie Park <jamie@acme.dev>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating parallel demo lanes & vendor bridge — please pick a lane

Thanks Priyom — we really appreciate the invite. Quick note from our side: the proposed Lane A (15:00 UTC) conflicts with an exec all-hands I can't move. Lane B at 22:00 UTC would be okay for our infra folks, but our product lead is only available 15:00–16:00 UTC on Friday (tight). Alternative options:

1) Move Acme to a slightly earlier slot on Friday (15:00 UTC is a conflict, but 13:00–14:00 UTC works for our exec and product leads).
2) If you keep the two-lane plan, we can join Lane B and ask our product lead to catch the shared Q&A (not ideal but workable).
3) Move to next Tuesday (Nov 9) entirely — we have a larger window then.

Also, Paul from DataForge mentioned they need confirmation if the demo will include a dedicated model instance (to test throughput). Is that something we can confirm?

Apologies for the back-and-forth — trying to keep the right folks in the room.

Best,
Jamie
Sr. Platform Engineer, Acme Corp
jamie@acme.dev

Appreciate the note, Jamie. Short plan to accommodate scheduling while keeping our hosting constraints minimal: 

- Priyom/Ben: can you run two 45-minute concurrent demos starting at 15:00 UTC (we'd push Acme earlier to 13:00 only if they confirm) — otherwise: start Lane A at 15:00 as proposed, and open Lane B at 15:30 local (overlap helps our shared Q&A). This lets product leads attend at least the demo portion.
- Ben: are you and Priyom available to cover 15:00–16:05 UTC? if yes we'll 1) schedule Lane A (15:00) 2) schedule Lane B (15:30) and rotate hosts so both prospects see the dedicated demo for the relevant features.
- Laura: please create tentative calendar holds for both lanes and mark them as "Proposed - pending confirmations". Add Zoom links and the bridge info; external invites only after we have final lane assignments.

Regarding dedicated capacity: Paul, quick answer — we can spin up a short-lived attended environment (2x T4 equivalent) for throughput testing, but we need 24h notice and a short MOU to keep costs covered. If you want this, reply with "Attended instance: yes" and we'll provision.

Vendor/marketplace bridge checklist: please run the attached vendor-network-checklist and confirm IPs to whitelist. If the partner requires a direct peering test, copy marketplace-partner@cloudhub.com on that reply.

I'll keep the thread on scheduling and we'll confirm final invites tomorrow.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Growth Engineering, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
